interface.shortDescription: Orient and continue from a local Project Brain.
interface.longDescription: Ley connects Codex to one explicitly selected local Project Brain through MCP, supported lifecycle capture, and the native $ley skill. It supplies bounded requirements, decisions, failed attempts, verification, and unfinished work with exact retained evidence and honest applicability warnings. Unregistered workspaces receive a local scope preview before any creation or attachment permission.
